description: A React component implementing a user login page with form validation, server communication, and navigation.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the API base URL from environment variables REACT_APP_API_BASE or REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, with trailing slashes removed.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates login input fields, ensuring username/email and password are provided.

methods.name: parseServerError
methods.description: Parses error messages from server response JSON, or defaults to a generic message with status code.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, performs validation, interacts with backend API, manages loading state, and navigates on success.
